findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: hometax__etax__invoice__issue, hometax__etax__invoice__modify, hometax__cash_receipt__daily_issue__search · Private data: hometax__session__login, hometax__certificate__apply__national_tax_payment, hometax__certificate__apply__tax_payment_record, hometax__certificate__apply__vat_standard, hometax__certificate__apply__business_registration, hometax__certificate__apply__financial_statement, hometax__certificate__apply__business_registration_reissue, hometax__tax__return_history__search_vat, hometax__tax__payment_statement__search, hometax__tax__trade_partner__search_list, hometax__cash_receipt__sales__search_history, hometax__cash_receipt__purchase__search_history, hometax__cash_receipt__daily_issue__search, hometax__certificate__apply_with_template, hometax__certificate__apply_auto, nhis_edi__public__notices__list, nhis_edi__public__resources__list, work24__subsidy__application__requirements, opendata__g2b__sanction, shinhan_easy__auth__id_password_session__login, kb_fast_account__session__login · Public sink: hometax__certificate__list, hometax__tax__payment_statement__search_submit_history, work24__subsidy__application__draft_validate, work24__subsidy__application__submit, work24__subsidy__application__withdraw, work24__subsidy__application__modify · Destructive: hometax__etax__invoice__search_statistics, hometax__etax__invoice__modify, work24__subsidy__application__draft_validate, work24__subsidy__application__submit, work24__subsidy__application__delete, work24__subsidy__application__modify.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: hometax__etax__invoice__issue, hometax__etax__invoice__modify, hometax__cash_receipt__daily_issue__search · Private data: hometax__session__login, hometax__certificate__apply__national_tax_payment, hometax__certificate__apply__tax_payment_record, hometax__certificate__apply__vat_standard, hometax__certificate__apply__business_registration, hometax__certificate__apply__financial_statement, hometax__certificate__apply__business_registration_reissue, hometax__tax__return_history__search_vat, hometax__tax__payment_statement__search, hometax__tax__trade_partner__search_list, hometax__cash_receipt__sales__search_history, hometax__cash_receipt__purchase__search_history, hometax__cash_receipt__daily_issue__search, hometax__certificate__apply_with_template, hometax__certificate__apply_auto, nhis_edi__public__notices__list, nhis_edi__public__resources__list, work24__subsidy__application__requirements, opendata__g2b__sanction, shinhan_easy__auth__id_password_session__login, kb_fast_account__session__login · Public sink: hometax__certificate__list, hometax__tax__payment_statement__search_submit_history, work24__subsidy__application__draft_validate, work24__subsidy__application__submit, work24__subsidy__application__withdraw, work24__subsidy__application__modify · Destructive: hometax__etax__invoice__search_statistics, hometax__etax__invoice__modify, work24__subsidy__application__draft_validate, work24__subsidy__application__submit, work24__subsidy__application__delete, work24__subsidy__application__modify

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
